subject.title: memory-wiki: per-agent / per-sessionKey scope for `includeCompiledDigestPrompt` and `registerMemoryPromptSupplement`

question: Should session/channel inclusion rules be owned by Memory Wiki configuration, or standardized as a policy for every registered memory prompt supplement?
rationale: Both designs are technically possible now, but a generic policy creates a lasting public SDK/config commitment without evidence that another supplement needs the same abstraction.

options.title: Keep policy in Memory Wiki
options.body: Add documented include/exclude session-key rules under Memory Wiki context configuration while leaving the generic builder contract contextual but policy-neutral.

options.title: Standardize supplement policy
options.body: Define reusable inclusion semantics for every memory prompt supplement and accept the broader plugin SDK and configuration contract.

recommendation.title: Keep policy in Memory Wiki
recommendation.body: Add documented include/exclude session-key rules under Memory Wiki context configuration while leaving the generic builder contract contextual but policy-neutral.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent cross-surface groundwork and explicitly framed this narrower unresolved policy decision.
